items.content_html:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/RTCRtpTransceiver/mid

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

Value

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

This value is null if negotiation has not completed.

What did you expect to see?

This value should be set to the MID of the "m=" section when a local or remote description is applyed, according to RFC 8829 that is referenced by WebRTC specification.

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

https://w3c.github.io/webrtc-pc/#dfn-jsepmid
https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8829#name-applying-a-local-descriptio
https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8829#name-applying-a-remote-descripti
https://w3c.github.io/webrtc-pc/#set-the-session-description
